messages:
Alex Chen: Kigali region readiness quick sync — need final signoff on routing, KMS residency, and legal checklist. Pinging infra/security/legal owners. PRs: https://git.redwood.dev/r/kgl/provisioning/pulls (2 open)
Maria Gonzalez: I can own KMS keys + residency docs. Which KMS region are we using? is it cloud-kigali-1 or cloud-kgl-1?
Rajiv Singh: We landed on cloud-kgl-1 yesterday in infra sync. Need Legal confirmation on data flow to backup region (dubai) for DR. @LegalBot any blockers?
LegalBot: quick note: cross-border backups to UAE require a DPA addendum and the retention table signed. I'll DM the legal template.
Jon Patel: Network note: peering ASN assigned, but we still need the NAT egress IP block from networking to register with cloud provider. I filed a small PR with terraform snippet. 
Tess O'Neil: Link to PR? I can review today. If we have IPs we can finish the route tables.
Jon Patel: PR: https://git.redwood.dev/r/kgl/networking/pulls/7 — includes egress CIDR placeholder: replace with allocated range. Example snippet: ```resource "cloud_ip_block" "kgl_egress" { count = var.allocate_egress ? 1 : 0  cidr = var.egress_cidr }```
Alex Chen: Thanks. Action items: (1) Legal to confirm DPA addendum (LegalBot), (2) Infra to allocate egress CIDR and update PR (Jon), (3) Maria to create KMS key and share key-id in this thread, (4) Tess to review networking PR by EOD. If any of these slip we gate the canary.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll stand up KMS key in cloud-kgl-1 tonight and post key-id. No secrets in thread — I'll paste key alias only: alias/redwood/kgl-prod.
Rajiv Singh: For routing policy, plan is to route customer traffic to kgl primary, fallback to dubai. We need auto-fallback policy in router config. I put a draft policy in the infra repo: https://git.redwood.dev/r/kgl/provisioning/commit/abc123
Tess O'Neil: Reviewing networking PR now. Quick Q: do we want prefix-lists for egress or explicit routes? Pref lists are easier for rotation.
Jon Patel: Prefix-lists + a small automation to rotate ranges during failover. I'll add that change.
LegalBot: Uploaded DPA addendum draft to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.dev/kgl-dpa. Please review and comment by tomorrow COB.
Alex Chen: Great. Can everyone react with :white_check_mark: once your item is done? We aim for canary start in 48 hours if all checks green.
Maria Gonzalez: :white_check_mark: (KMS alias created, will send onboarding ticket to security for key policy review)
Tess O'Neil: Reviewing now — will mark when merged.
Jon Patel: Need final IP allocation from cloud team. Pinged @infra-bot to escalate.
infra-bot: Escalation created: ticket #KGL-IP-112 to cloud-ops for egress block. ETA 6 hours.
Rajiv Singh: Noted. If cloud-ops misses ETA, fallback is to reserve a temp /24 for canary only.
Alex Chen: OK. If all goes well, schedule a 09:00 UTC canary kickoff in two days. I'll post runbook snippet in the morning. Thanks all.
